decisions.reason: The source's identity-level timelessness clarification is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no additional update or removal is required.
The source refines the internal composition of the Hero V, not the kerning, rhythm, or hierarchy of the complete wordmark.
Selecting and refining the Hero V does not alter the deferred rule that the É accent will later derive from the resolved Hero V geometry.
The supporting V must still derive from the Hero V, but the source does not establish a new supporting-V form or change its existing derivation rule.
The source changes Hero V geometry and character without changing the deferred champagne-metal treatment, its qualities, or its application sequence.
The source concerns the Hero V only and does not resume or modify the deferred construction and visual language of the remaining wordmark letterforms.
The source refines arm presence, movement, and relationship but does not change the terminal treatment or its structural, non-decorative design basis.
The Hero V refinement leaves unchanged the requirement for a wordmark-led identity without a separate icon or monogram.
